camel_example: aliyun eiam ListApplicationsForUser --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --UserId user_d6sbsuumeta4h66ec3il7yxxxx
description_en: Calls the ListApplicationsForUser operation to perform a paging query on the list of applications accessible to an EIAM account. The response includes application IDs. To obtain detailed application information, call the GetApplication operation
description_zh: 调用ListApplicationsForUser接口，分页查询一个EIAM账户可访问的应用列表，返回的结果中，包含应用ID信息，如需获取应用详细信息，请调用GetApplication接口
kebab_example: aliyun eiam list-applications-for-user --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --user-id user_d6sbsuumeta4h66ec3il7yxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListApplicationsForUser

parameters.help_en: The list of application IDs. A single request supports up to 100 application IDs
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID列表，单次操作最多支持100个应用ID
parameters.name: application_ids

parameters.help_en:
The query mode. Default value: OnlyDirect. Valid values:

OnlyDirect: Queries only the direct permissions of the account, which are the applications directly assigned to the account.
IncludeInherit: Queries both the direct permissions and inherited permissions of the account. Inherited permissions refer to the permissions that the account inherits from its parent organizations or the groups to which it belongs
parameters.help_zh:
查询模式，默认为 OnlyDirect ，取值可选范围：

OnlyDirect：代表只查询账户的直属权限，即直接分配给账户的应用。
IncludeInherit：代表既查询账户的直属权限，也查询账户的继承权限。继承权限是指账户通过其父级组织（或者其隶属的组）继承的权限
parameters.name: query_mode

Applications.description_en: The list of applications that the account is authorized to access
Applications.description_zh: 被授权访问的应用列表

items.description_en: The application that the account is authorized to access

ApplicationRoles.description_en: The list of application roles. No roles are returned for SAML applications
ApplicationRoles.description_zh: 应用角色列表。SAML应用无角色返回
ApplicationRoles.title_en: 应用角色列表。SAML应用无角色返回
ApplicationRoles.title_zh: 应用角色列表。SAML应用无角色返回

HasDirectAuthorization.description_en:
Indicates whether direct authorization exists. Valid values:

true: A direct authorization record exists between the application and the account.
false: No direct authorization record exists between the application and the account
HasDirectAuthorization.description_zh:
是否存在直属授权，取值范围：

true： 应用与账户存在直接的赋权关系记录。
false： 应用与账户不存在直接的赋权关系记录

HasInheritAuthorization.description_en:
Indicates whether inherited authorization exists. Valid values:

true: A direct authorization record exists between the application and at least one parent organization of the account or a group to which the account belongs.
false: No direct authorization record exists between the application and any parent organization of the account or any group to which the account belongs
HasInheritAuthorization.description_zh:
是否存在继承授权，取值范围：

true：应用与账户的任意一个父级组织（或者账户隶属的组）存在直接的赋权关系记录。
false：应用与账户的所有父级组织（或者账户隶属的组）都不存在直接的赋权关系记录
